    weight_block = 0.30 * (1 + 0.03 * utilization) * (1 + 0.005 * (DIFF / (DIFF + 1e-6)))
    weight_curvature = 0.20 * (1 - utilization) * (1 + 0.005 * (DIFF / (DIFF + 1e-6)))
    weight_space = 0.15 * (1 + 0.03 * (EMP + 1)**0.7) * (1 + 0.006 * (1 - (AVG - CUR) / (CUR + 1 + epsilon)))
    weight_diff = 0.10 * (1 + utilization) * (1 + 0.005 * (DIFF / (DIFF + 1e-6)))

    # Final priority score with curvature normalization, entropy smoothing, and lookahead sensitivity
    priority = (weight_urgency * urgency_factor) + (weight_block * block_factor) + \
               (weight_curvature * curvature_factor) + (weight_space * space_factor) + \
               (weight_diff * max(0, -DIFF) * (1 + utilization)) - (0.015 * (1 - utilization) * (1 + utilization))

    return priority
